from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly references or cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of parsed data for all documents in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
